```plato
    //==
    // # The IPointCloud3D obligations
    //
    // Every enriched cloud keeps its samples in Positions and its channels in
    // arrays parallel to it, so dropping to a bare cloud is dropping the
    // channels. Written as an explicit construction rather than a bare array
    // body: PointCloud3D's single field is an Array, and a C# backend cannot
    // declare the implicit conversion for it (CS0552).

    // The positions, without the per-point normals.
    ToPointCloud(self: OrientedPointCloud3D): PointCloud3D
        => PointCloud3D(self.Positions);
```
